weight_semantics: daily sleeve returns; weights for date t are determined by information through t-1 for dynamic rules
cost_note: sleeve returns are net/costed where the source sleeve provides net returns; inter-sleeve allocation turnover cost is not modeled

rules.dyn_microcap_20_if_dd_le_5: Microcap 20% if prior Microcap NAV drawdown is within 5%; otherwise 15%; Sub-B absorbs the difference.
rules.dyn_microcap_20_if_above_ma126: Microcap 20% if prior Microcap NAV is above prior 126-day moving average; otherwise 15%; Sub-B absorbs the difference.
rules.dyn_microcap_20_if_above_ma126_and_dd_le: Microcap 20% only if prior NAV is above prior 126-day MA and within 10% drawdown; otherwise 15%; Sub-B absorbs the difference.
rules.dyn_microcap_10_15_20_by_dd_5_10: Microcap 20% if prior drawdown is within 5%, 10% if prior drawdown is worse than 10%, otherwise 15%; Sub-B absorbs the difference.
